content.text: Lawkkanem ni lungkhueknae a roum sak,
hatei lawkkahram ni lungkhueknae a pâhlaw.
Tamilungkaang e lai ni teh, panuenae hah kalan lah ouk a hno,
hatei tamipathu ni teh pathunae hah
a pahni dawk hoi ouk a tâco sak.
BAWIPA e mit teh hmuen tangkuem a kâhlai teh
hnokahawi hoi hnokathout hah ouk a khet.
A tak ka dam e lai teh hringnae thingkung doeh,
hatei lawkkahram ni teh lung a mathoe sak.
Tamipathu ni a na pa e cangkhainae hah banglah ngâi hoeh,
hatei yuenae ka tarawi e tami teh kho ka pouk thai e doeh.
Tamikalan im vah hnopai moikapap ao teh,
tamikathout ni a hmu e teh rucatnae hah doeh.
Tamilungkaang e pahni ni teh panuenae a pung sak,
hatei tamipathu e lungthin ni teh hottelah sak boihoeh.
Tamikathout ni thueng e teh BAWIPA hanelah panuet a tho,
hatei tamikalan ni ratoum e teh a lunghawinae doeh.
Tamikathout hringnuen teh BAWIPA hanelah panuet a tho,
hatei lannae katarawinaw hah teh a lung a pataw.
Lam kalan kaphennaw teh puenghoi yue lah ao teh,
yuenae kahmuhmanaw teh a due han.
Sheol hoi rawkphainae teh BAWIPA hmalah a kamnue,
tami canaw e lungthin teh hoe a kamnue han.
Ka dudam e tami teh yuenae ngai hoeh,
tamilungkaang koehai cet ngai hoeh.
Lungthin nawmnae ni minhmai a pan sak teh,
lungreithainae teh lungreknae doeh.
Thaipanueknae lungthin ka tawn e ni panuenae ouk a tawng,
hatei tamipathu ni teh pathunae lawk hoi ouk a kâkawk.
Runae kâhmo e tami hanelah teh hnin pueng kathout seng doeh,
hatei lungthin kanawm e ni teh pawi pou tonae lah ao.
BAWIPA taki laihoi younca tawn e teh
baruengbaraw o laihoi moikapap tawn e hlak a hawihnawn.
Lungpatawnae lahoi ankahring hoi vai touh ca e teh,
kâhmuhmanae koe maito buem pui ca e hlak ahawihnawn.
Tami lungkathout ni kâyuenae a tâcokhai,
hatei ka panguep thai e ni teh a roum sak.
Kapangaknaw e lamthung teh pâkhing hoi khak a cak,
hatei tamikalannaw e lamthung teh a ngaca.
Capa a lungkaang ni teh a na pa a konawm sak,
ka pathu e ni teh a manu a dumdam.
Lungangnae ka tawn hoeh e naw niteh
pathunae heh a lunghawinae lah a o,
hatei thaipanueknae katawnnaw teh kalancalah ouk a cei awh.
Kâpankhainae awm hoeh pawiteh
noenae hai kangcoung thai hoeh,
hatei kâpankhaikung pap pawiteh noenae a kangcoung.
Pahni hoi dei e lawk ni lunghawinae a tâco sak,
a tue a pha torei dei e lawk teh ahawi poung.
Tamilungkaangnaw e hringnae lamthung teh kahlun lah a luen,
hothateh rahim lae sheol lam dawk hoi a kamlang thainae doeh.
BAWIPA ni tami kâoupnaw e im hah a raphoe pouh han,
hatei lahmainu imhmuen teh a caksak han.
Tamikathoutnaw e pouknae teh BAWIPA hanelah panuet a tho,
hatei a lung kathoungnaw lawk teh thai a nawm.
Ka hounloun e ni ama imthung totouh runae a poe,
hatei tadawnghno ka hmuhma e teh a hring han.
Tamikalan lungthin ni teh pato nahane hmaloe a kamtu,
hatei tamikathout e pahni ni teh hnokathout ouk a tâco sak.
BAWIPA teh tamikathout koehoi ahla,
hatei tamikalan e ratoumnae teh ouk a thai.
Lunghawinae minhmai ni lungthin a nawm sak teh,
kamthang kahawi teh hru hanelah hawinae lah ao.
Hring tounnae ka tarawi e tami teh
tamilungkaangnaw koe pouh ao han.

content: Cangkhainae banglah ka pouk hoeh e tami teh

content.text: amae hringnae banglah ka pouk hoeh e tami doeh,
hatei yuenae alawkpui lah ka pouk e ni thaipanueknae a hmu.
BAWIPA takinae teh lungangnae cangkhainae lah o teh,
barinae ao hoehnahlan kârahnoumnae hmaloe ao.
